decisions.decision: Foundational Wave 7 deletions built inline instead of by workers
decisions.why: the removals were mutually dependent and only compiled together
decisions.rejected: splitting them across workers that could not build independently

decisions.decision: Preview no longer blocks during a save; its request waits for the save queue to drain (authoringIdle)
decisions.why: R13 and FR-019 say the preview opens and sends only after the queue is idle, and T054 tests a preview opened mid-save
decisions.rejected: blocking preview controls with ДОЖДИТЕСЬ СОХРАНЕНИЯ

decisions.decision: The read-only-demo control reason is not implemented
decisions.why: the bundled demo cannot be opened in place (session service refuses it), so no input reaches that branch
decisions.rejected: a dead branch that no state can trigger

decisions.decision: Bar control reasons are visually hidden but exposed through aria-describedby and title; facility workspace reasons are visible
decisions.why: idle undo/redo reasons would clutter the shared bar
decisions.rejected: always-visible reason text in the bar

decisions.decision: #commandEffects uses data-kind terminal-transition for a terminal-transition command, and the contract was updated
decisions.why: a device transition and a terminal transition are different effects

decisions.decision: The scene reset dialog updates its pending-request line on coordination events while it is open
decisions.why: a player request always opens its own modal, so the note can only appear for a request that arrives while the dialog is open
decisions.rejected: a pending note computed only when the dialog opens

decisions.decision: The scene reset counts against currentSessionRevision() (worker fix)
decisions.why: matches dependency inspection and terminal-group saves; fixtures open at a non-zero revision
decisions.rejected: newestDurableRevision, which is 0 right after open

decisions.decision: The facility-player-state fixture now emits session-state after an approved command
decisions.why: the real app publishes session-state after command execution (app.go), and the Overseer refreshes the player view from it
decisions.rejected: refreshing the player view on every coordination event

decisions.decision: Preview summary takes block numbers from the authored terminal
decisions.why: The player ContentEntry carries only the joined description, so projected trees have no block IDs in the app
decisions.rejected: Adding blocks to the public player projection

decisions.decision: Fixture preview strips entry blocks from projected trees
decisions.why: Mirror the player contract so journeys catch app-only gaps
decisions.rejected: Leaving the fixture richer than the app

decisions.why: Session validation forbids two holding rules of one kind per target, so cancellation never reaches the form

concerns.note: One full browser run (dot reporter, recorded as exit 201) failed in a test that could not be identified; the line-reporter reruns before and after passed 316/316. There may be an intermittent browser test.

task test:race failed once in internal/player TestPresentationUplinkBodyActivityResetsOnlyIdleDeadline (idle-deadline timing under load, code untouched by this feature); it passed -count=5 alone and on the full rerun.

currentSessionRevision() falls back to the startup status revision. After a webview reload with an active session, then opening another file, the first scene reset would come back stale once and then recount. The proper fix is for the open result to carry the session revision.
The interactive packaged-app pass (quickstart steps 1-5 and the compatibility check by hand) was not run.
On the state-changing-command routes, SaveAuthoring and ResetScene are page fakes that do not reach the player coordinator; publication to real players is covered only on facility-player-state.

Quickstart step 2.2 cannot be performed: the command approval dialog is modal and Escape rejects, so the Overseer cannot edit while a request is pending; the pending rebase (R4) is reachable only through API-level tests
Packaged-app run had click-only control (app name contains Terminal); typed quickstart edits were replaced by click-only edits
Full browser suite (320 passed, 2 skipped) and the packaged-app quickstart were run in-session, not through --verify-run, to avoid a second 5-minute run
